extract.description: An unidentified person deliberately scratched the parked vehicle doors.

followup.question: On what date did this happen? Were the police informed, and were there any witnesses?

compose.answer: In claim_types_policy.pdf, page 4, the fictional wording excludes this own-vehicle event for the selected liability-only test product [P.4]. Page 6 provides no own-vehicle compensation for that product [P.6]. A claims handler must check the case.
